caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with a central arch made of alternating red and yellow triangles, supported by two red columns with yellow and white accents, standing on black bases. Inside the arch, there are six stylized flowers with red and yellow petals and black centers, extending from a common base at the bottom center and curving outward. At the top of the arch, there are three tulip-like flowers with red, yellow, and black petals. On either side of the columns, facing inward, are two birds with black heads, white beaks, yellow wings, red tails, and red and white neck bands, each holding a small object in its beak. In the upper left and upper right corners, there are two identical circular geometric patterns with red, black, and white sections, surrounded by yellow petal shapes, resembling stylized rosettes. The background is a solid teal color, and the entire composition is set against a cream-colored border.
title: Study for Proposed Portfolio "Decorated Chests of Rural Pennsylvania"
